title: Parallelizable Exact Synthesis of Quantum Circuits via Semi-Tensor Product
summary: Exact synthesis is a key infrastructure in quantum circuit synthesis and optimization, which provides optimal implementations of small circuit shards and is widely used as a circuit re-synthesis optimization kernel. However, existing quantum exact synthesis methods suffer from encoding overhead, memory bottlenecks, and poor parallel scalability. In this work, we introduce a parallel exact synthesis framework for CNOT and phase polynomial circuits based on the semi-tensor product (STP) theory of matrices that avoids these issues.
